phases.text: One playthrough is enough, every trophy is offline, and there are no mission gold medals and no mission replay — so play the story once and clean up afterwards. Turn cheats off before you start: GTABase and TechWiser report that any cheat disables trophy tracking and saving, and only a clean save fixes it. PowerPyx and GTABase put the whole platinum at roughly 200 hours.
phases.title: Before you start

phases.text: The only trophy anyone flags as possibly missable lives here. Meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — GTABase and PowerPyx both report that this spot is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it while you can. Start every stranger strand the moment it appears: TechWiser warns some of them have windows tied to story progress.
phases.title: Chapter 1 — do this first

phases.text: Just play. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies pop as you finish each chapter and mission, and the final mission's gold pops at the end. After the story, free roam stays open and the 100% completion checklist unlocks.
phases.title: Play the story

phases.text: Finish the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt the unique animal for Bret, and complete any three more strands to reach eight. Each finished strand also feeds the 100% checklist.
phases.title: Strangers and side missions

phases.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations, finish 250 stunts, win 20 races, try every activity type once, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, and complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Most of these overlap with the 100% checklist, which asks for a little more of each.
phases.title: Activities and skills

phases.text: Complete 3 card sets, scan 100 WAiNK locations, scan 100 vehicles, and clear the fog from all 52 areas of Leonida. Fly over the dark patches on the map to unfog them quickly.
phases.title: Collectibles and the map

phases.text: Rob 5 bank vaults (after the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…”), an armored truck, and one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob 3 shops in a row with them, and rob a jewelry store unseen. Launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy the 8 garages, and register 10 vehicles.
phases.title: Crime and money

phases.text: Work the checklist the game unlocks after the story: 300 stunts, 30 races, 70 challenges, 15 card sets and 8 bank vaults are the numbers above the trophy targets. The odd ones out — the cocktail on Ocean Beach, the showroom smash, the strange event, the second try, the melee drive-by — are still unconfirmed, so check the guides and try what the descriptions suggest. When the last trophy pops, the platinum is yours.
phases.title: Clean-up and the platinum
